name: audiobook-codex
description: Native-only Codex workflow for mapping books, producing faithful text, and rendering local Kokoro audiobooks.

interface.shortDescription: Map books, verify text, and render local audiobook audio.
interface.longDescription: A Codex-only audiobook workflow for PDF and EPUB sources. It uses native PDF and Computer Use capabilities when available, Codex agents for visual transcription, and a local Kokoro runtime for PT-BR audio.
